properties.error_model: The core is deterministic and must stay so, so a backend failure is returned to the caller rather than retried or defaulted — a fabricated answer would put LLM output inside a deterministic result (`req:deterministic-core`, `req:no-silent-fallback`).
properties.name: LlmBackend — the one seam between the deterministic core and any LLM
properties.payload_schema: crates/reflow2-core/src/llm.rs — the `LlmBackend` trait. The deterministic core never names a provider; it holds a `&dyn LlmBackend`.
